state.goal: Select an owning generated/runtime formatting seam for the Can compiler while preserving existing pure public API compatibility, source named/positional behavior, exact numeric/temporal values, outbound whole-message locale fallback/provenance, defaulted message parameters, source argument evaluation once/order, and precise failures. This is a production contract decision before released edits, not a claim of implementation.
state.verified: Actual freshly built packages/values/dist/catalog.json has format(template:text,values:closed object of Display)->text and format(descriptor:message,locale:locale?)->text, exactly two required args. analysis try_overload computes exact argument-index slots and selects specificity with catalog-order ties but discards winning binding. IR first-arity reconstructs ordinary named builtin calls; format special lowering retains only unnamed first argument and literal named locale, drops plain values and dynamic/positional locale. JS emits format(c,UI_message,{locale}). Current actual stdlib verbatim reexports values format(first,second). Values plain returns string. Values message accepts only its kind:message descriptor, explicit locale and appDefault options, sourceLang default en and timeZone default UTC, returning frozen {text,locale}. Actual UI MessageFactory descriptor omits kind and uses canonical type strings, including qualified enums/url/email/etc; values descriptor uses closed param kinds text/bool/enum/int/decimal/money/date/datetime, rejecting url type. Actual UI formatter expects date/datetime strings and rejects values tagged objects (prior verified owner evidence); values formatter accepts exact tagged DateValue/DatetimeValue/Decimal. Actual CLI production artifacts plain and message both throw invalid-construction through actual imports. Removing c alone does not fix descriptor/options/result mismatch. Named message/derive calls check clean but IR refuses them; omitted message/derive defaults check clean but generated artifact drops them. InvocationContext contract has team.timezone, no appDefaultLocale. Checked module effects retain source_lang and explicit locale_default; composition default should derive selected app merged context, default en. DESIGN section13 context signature is proposed desired target, not installed API. Public facade has direct callers tested today. Full selected-call facts need cohort owned same DB/catalog instance guard now accepted; no generic reconstruction or duplicate authority registry permitted.
state.constraints: No app-authored wrapper/helper, copied default/type registry, implicit viewer locale, JS Number conversion, erased selected locale, or mocked installed facades. Preserve owning declarations as source authority and exact public pure format behavior/failures. Both options require explicit ownership of any app-default/source-language/carrier bridge and actual generated program/import tests; current installed APIs alone do not trump proposed language outcomes. Compare total coherent closure, not a tiny broken patch versus complete alternative. Proposed context signature may be revised with evidence.

alternatives.generated_adapter: Retain existing public values/stdlib two-argument format unchanged. Define a separate producer-owned generated adapter seam (new helper or explicit checked lowering to existing pure APIs) that bridges canonical generated message descriptors/normalized parameter kinds to exact values carriers, passes checked merged app default/source language plus trusted context timezone explicitly, and preserves FormattedMessage provenance at sinks. Plain source format lowers directly to public format(template,values). Any adapter is library-owned/reusable or mechanically emitted from checked declarations, never an app-authored handwritten helper. Requires qualified compatibility contract, export assembly if helper selected, no silent heuristic of unknown canonical type IDs, and tests. Existing desired format(c,...) spelling changes or maps to that generated adapter.
alternatives.facade_extension: Extend producer values format and stdlib verbatim exports with an additional backwards-compatible context-aware generated overload alongside existing two-argument public overloads. The generated overload explicitly receives checked app-default/source-language options (InvocationContext alone lacks app default), accepts canonical generated descriptors via a specified exact-carrier/parameter-kind contract, and returns provenance-preserving output. Plain generated and public paths retain existing pure behavior. No guessing arbitrary type strings or Number conversion. Requires all directly affected producer contracts/catalog/build/tests and compatibility controls; keeps desired context-aware target name but overload admission must avoid ambiguous context versus descriptor dispatch.
